summary: Comprehensive backend (pytest) and frontend (playwright) testing of Pulse AI. All 20 backend tests pass and all listed frontend flows function correctly: cockpit + brief (Claude mode) + leakages + intervention persistence + journeys + simulation + data quality + evaluation. Mobile bottom nav and hard refresh on all routes work.

issues: Region selector is a native <select> rather than a shadcn/custom dropdown — functional but plain styling. Acceptable but not premium.
PRD text 'No external system writeback' is rendered as 'No external writeback' (minor copy difference).

action_items: OPTIONAL: align copy in LeakageDetail.js line 130 from 'No external writeback' to 'No external system writeback' to match PRD wording.
OPTIONAL: consider using a styled dropdown for region selector instead of native <select> for visual consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: brief endpoint uses 60s timeout in axios; backend can return mode='model' in ~20s under Claude, fallback path exercised separately — all good.
Interventions persist via MongoDB and survive page reload (verified).
All endpoints exclude MongoDB _id correctly via _clean helper.
Frontend uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL throughout (no hardcoded URLs).
data-testid attributes are present on every interactive element required by PRD.
Synthetic Demo Data badge visible globally; no PII columns in journeys (pseudonymous LEAD-* IDs confirmed).
test_credentials: N/A — no auth in Pulse AI.
seed_data_creation: Backend startup seeds 6 interventions deterministically; test_assign_update_persistence mutated one intervention to OWNER-NEHA / Assigned / 2026-12-31 with note 'TEST_assigned'. test_status_transitions advanced INT-0001 through Reviewed -> In Progress -> Proof Required -> Closed. Frontend interaction test left LEAK-002 intervention with status 'In Progress' and a TEST_review_note note. These mutations are non-destructive seed-state changes only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_pulse_api.py is fully passing. EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is set and Claude Sonnet 4.6 brief returns mode='model' in <30s. Note that mutated intervention state from tests (Assigned/In Progress, OWNER-NEHA on LEAK-002) persists in MongoDB; if tests should run from a clean state, drop the interventions collection or use a separate test DB.
rca of the issue: No critical issues found. The two minor design notes are stylistic/copy-level and do not affect functionality.
